newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean president reshuffles his cabinet.
newsitem.headline: South Korean president reshuffles his cabinet.

text.p: South Korean president Kim Young-sam, his government tainted by corruption scandals, will reshuffle his cabinet on Friday.

A spokesman for the presidential Blue House announced a string of new appointments at a number of ministries, including the ministries of Trade, Industry and Energy. A new police chief will also be appointed.
